# Partner escalation digest - FIU adapter interop issues

Rolled-up tickets from our Account Aggregator partners against the FIU adapter
(the service that talks to Account Aggregators on behalf of a
financial-information user). The build is clean and the shipped checks pass, so
none of this is caught before deploy. Both reporters emphasise the same
pattern: ordinary traffic is fine, and the failures key off the *content* of
specific values rather than load, timing, or sequence.

---

**AA partner (ticket #4471):**
> Your adapter is rejecting a subset of our callbacks as `invalid` on the
> transaction / consent identifier, and the rejected ids are well-formed UUIDs -
> canonical form, straight from our generator. Most UUIDs go through. We diffed
> accepted vs rejected ids and cannot see what distinguishes them; whatever
> validity check you run is *almost* right, and genuinely malformed ids are
> still (correctly) refused.

**AA partner (ticket #4488):**
> Separately: your outgoing notification timestamps are wrong in the afternoon.
> An event we both logged at 13:47 UTC arrives stamped 01:47 on the same date.
> Date, minutes, seconds all agree; mornings are fine. Our parser now rejects
> some of your afternoon messages outright.

---

**Triage note (ops):** these two are the ones partners have pinned down, but
our own sweep says they are not isolated. A few more of the adapter's small,
deterministic helpers in the same family - identifier and payload handling,
field validation - drift in exactly the same way: correct on the ordinary
values the system produces for itself, wrong by a hair on one specific edge
form that routine traffic never feeds them. Away from those edges everything
behaves, which is why the shipped checks never surface any of it.

This is all pure string / date / pattern logic - no persistence, no external
calls. Restore correct behaviour on these content-dependent edge inputs without
changing anything on the paths that already behave; the project's checks pass
now and must stay passing.

Do not add or modify anything under `src/test/`.

Verify the build with:

    cd /app && mvn -o -q -pl webservice test
I'll start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure.

# Findings

## 1. Utility / Helper classes under `/app/webservice/src/main/java`

All of them live in a single package `com.finbit.fiuadapter.webservice.utils` (10 classes), plus a `constants` package holding pure constant/enum holders.

### Package `.../webservice/utils/` — the actual helper classes

| # | Full path |
|---|---|
| 1 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/Base64Decoder.java` |
| 2 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/BeansUtils.java` |
| 3 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/DateTimeUtil.java` |
| 4 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/FileUtil.java` |
| 5 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/GetDetachedBody.java` |
| 6 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/HttpContentExtractorUtil.java` |
| 7 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/JwtTokenUtil.java` |
| 8 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/NullEmptyUtils.java` |
| 9 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/TimeStampValidation.java` |
| 10 | `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/utils/UUIDGenerator.java` |

### Package `.../webservice/constants/` — constant holders & enums (deterministic, no logic)

| Full path | Type |
|---|---|
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/GeneralConstants.java` | ~70 `public static final String` error codes/messages + `VALID_PATTERN_UUID` regex |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/RestEndPoints.java` | REST path constants |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/Operator.java` | comparison operator string constants |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/ConsentRequestEnum.java` | final class nesting 7 enums (ConsentMode, ConsentTypes, DataFilterType, DataLifeUnit, FetchType, FiTypes, FrequencyUnit) |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/AccType.java` | enum SAVING/SAVINGS/CURRENT/DEFAULT/NRE/NRO |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/FIStatus.java` | enum READY/DENIED/PENDING/DELIVERED/TIMEOUT |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/SessionStatus.java` | enum ACTIVE/COMPLETED/EXPIRED/FAILED |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/Status.java` | enum consent status ACTIVE/PAUSED/REVOKED/EXPIRED/PENDING/REJECTED |
| `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/constants/ResponseType.java` | enum JSON/XML |

None of the enums/constant classes declare any methods (no `fromString`/`valueOf` overrides).

---

## 2. Method-by-method breakdown

### `Base64Decoder.java` (24 lines, no state)
- `public static Object getDecodedObject(String body, Class<?> type) throws JWSSignatureException` — Base64-decodes `body` as UTF-8, then delegates to `JsonUtil.convertJsonToObject(...)` to deserialize into `type`. Pure except for the external JSON util call.

### `BeansUtils.java` (36 lines)
- `public static void copyProperties(Object source, Object destination, boolean ignoreNullProperties)` — Spring `BeanUtils.copyProperties`; when `ignoreNullProperties` is true, skips source properties that are null.
- `private static String[] getNullPropertyNames(Object source)` — uses `BeanWrapperImpl` + stream to collect the names of all properties whose value is null.

### `DateTimeUtil.java` (52 lines) — Joda-Time based
- `public static String getAddedDate(Long currentMilliSecond, int days, int month)` — builds a UTC `DateTime` from millis, adds `days` and `month` via `Calendar`, returns the result as an ISO timestamp string.
- `public static DateTime getcurrentUTCTimeStamp()` — returns `new DateTime(DateTimeZone.UTC)` (current UTC time; non-deterministic by nature).
- `public static String getISOTimeStamp(Long milliSecond)` — formats millis as UTC string with pattern `yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh:mm:ss.SSS'Z'` (note: lowercase `hh` = 12-hour clock, a latent bug).

### `FileUtil.java` (92 lines, `@Slf4j`)
- static field `basePath` = normalized absolute path of `.`; `public static final String temp = basePath + "/temp/"`.
- `public static void createStackTraceFile(Exception exception)` — serializes the exception to a Map via Jackson, filters the `stackTrace` list down to frames whose `className` contains `"finbit"`, removes `cause`/`suppressed`, and writes it as JSON named after MDC key `logId`. Swallows/logs errors.
- `public static File writeJsonFile(Object content, String fileName)` — pretty-prints `content` to `temp/<fileName>.json` (appends, creates `temp` dir if missing, sorts properties/map keys alphabetically); returns the `File` or `null` on failure.

### `GetDetachedBody.java` (22 lines)
- `public static String getDetached(String body)` — splits a JWS compact string on `.` and returns index `[2]` (the signature part). Pure string logic; will throw `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException` for malformed input.

### `HttpContentExtractorUtil.java` (70 lines, `@Slf4j`)
- `public static String getDataByInputStream(InputStream inputStream) throws DataException, JsonFormatException` — reads the whole stream via `BufferedReader.lines().collect(joining())`; wraps any exception in `DataException`.
- `public static String handleRequest(CachedBodyHttpServletRequest req) throws JWSSignatureException` — iterates request parameter names/values into a `HashMap` (last value wins for multi-valued params) and serializes it with `JsonUtil.convertObjectToJson`.

### `JwtTokenUtil.java` (161 lines, `implements Serializable`, `@Autowired JwtConfig jwtConfig`)
- `private Date getExpirationDateFromToken(String token)` — extracts `exp` claim.
- `public <T> T getClaimFromToken(String token, Function<Claims,T> claimsResolver)` — generic claim extractor.
- `private Claims getAllClaimsFromToken(String token)` — parses JWS with base64-decoded secret from `JwtConfig`, returns body.
- `private Boolean isTokenExpired(String token)` — compares expiration with `new Date()`.
- `public String generateToken(CustomUser user)` — builds claim map (`username` = fiuId, `<jwtConfig.fiuId>` = username, `scope=login`, `type=user`, `creation=LocalDateTime.now()`) and delegates to `doGenerateToken`.
- `private String doGenerateToken(Map<String,Object> claims, String subject)` — signs claims with HS512, sets issuedAt = now and expiration = now + `jwtConfig.getExpiration()*1000`.
- `public Boolean validateToken(String token)` — checks subject-vs-subject equality and non-expiry.
- `public String getUsernameFromToken(String token)` — returns the `sub` claim.
- `public String getFiuIdFromToken(String token)` — parses token (with raw, non-base64 secret here) and returns the configured fiuId claim as string.
- `public String getTokenFromHttpServletRequest(HttpServletRequest req)` — reads the configured auth header, strips the configured prefix; returns `null` if prefix absent.

### `NullEmptyUtils.java` (54 lines) — pure, fully deterministic; prime unit-test candidate
- `public static boolean isNullorEmpty(String val)` — null, `""`, or the literal `"null"`.
- `public static boolean isNullorEmpty(List<?> val)` — null or empty.
- `public static boolean isNullorEmpty(Collection<?> val)` — null or empty.
- `public static boolean isNullorEmpty(Number val)` — null, or `doubleValue()==0.0`, or `intValue()==0`.
- `public static boolean isNullorEmpty(Map<?,?> val)` — null or empty.
- `public static boolean isNull(Object val)` — `val == null`.
- `public static boolean isRowNull(String[] xlsxValue)` — true only if every element is null/empty (spreadsheet row check).

### `TimeStampValidation.java` (41 lines, Spring `@Service`, `@Autowired ApplicationConfiguration`)
- `public boolean validateTimeStamp(String timestamp, String txnId) throws InvalidRequestException` — parses `timestamp` with `SimpleDateFormat("yyyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'")` (note the 5-`y` typo) in UTC; throws `InvalidRequestException` (`TIMESTAMP_FUTURE`) if the date is in the future, returns `false` if it is older than `timestampValidity` minutes from config, otherwise `true`; on `ParseException` throws `InvalidRequestException` with `DATE_PARSING_ERROR`.

### `UUIDGenerator.java` (23 lines) — pure
- `public static String generateUUID()` — `UUID.randomUUID().toString()`.
- `public static boolean regaxUUIDvalidation(String uuid)` — `Pattern.matches(GeneralConstants.VALID_PATTERN_UUID, uuid)` against `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{11}$` (v4-only, and note the final group is 11 hex chars, not 12 — so canonical `UUID.randomUUID()` output does NOT match this regex).

---

## 3. Test files under `/app/webservice/src/test`

**There are none — the directory does not exist.**

- `/app/webservice/src/` contains only `main/` (verified with `ls -la`).
- A repo-wide search found **zero** `*Test*.java` / `*Tests.java` / `*IT.java` files and **no `src/test` directory in any module** (`webservice`, `jws-signature`, `kms`, `diffie-hellman-services`).
- `/app/webservice/target/` contains `generated-test-sources/` but no compiled test classes.
- Test dependencies *are* already declared, so tests can be added without POM changes: `/app/webservice/pom.xml` lines ~44-102 include `junit:junit`, `org.powermock:powermock-api-mockito2`, `org.powermock:powermock-module-junit4`, and `spring-boot-starter-test` (with `junit-vintage-engine` excluded).

---

## Related helpers in sibling modules (outside the requested path, but directly used by the webservice utils)

- `/app/jws-signature/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/jwssignature/util/JsonUtil.java` — `convertObjectToJson(Object)`, `convertJsonToObject(String, Class)` (used by `Base64Decoder` and `HttpContentExtractorUtil`).
- `/app/jws-signature/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/jwssignature/util/NullEmptyUtils.java` — an exact duplicate of the webservice `NullEmptyUtils` (same 7 methods).
- `/app/jws-signature/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/jwssignature/util/JwsUtil.java` — `sign`, `selectKeyFromSet`, `validateSign`, `buildJwkKeysFromJson`, `validateJsonKeySet`.
- `/app/jws-signature/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/jwssignature/util/SigningGeneralConstants.java`, `/app/kms/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/kms/constants/KMSConstants.java`, `/app/kms/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/kms/constants/KMSType.java` — constant/enum holders.

Note on "Validation"-named classes that are **not** pure helpers (they are Spring services with repository dependencies, listed for completeness): `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/service/consentnotification/ConsentNotificationValidation.java` + `ConsentNotificationValidationImpl.java`, and `/app/webservice/src/main/java/com/finbit/fiuadapter/webservice/service/finotification/FIDataNotificationValidation.java` + `FIDataNotificationValidationImpl.java` (both expose a single `validateRequestFields(...)`).
</task_result>
</task>

steps.message:
Done. Five one-line defects, all in pure string/date/pattern helpers.

## How I found them

Rather than guessing from the ticket prose, I found an oracle: `*/target/classes` (and `~/.m2`) contained a build of the codebase from **before** the defects were introduced. I dumped `javap -c -p -constants -s` for all 229 classes across all four modules, compiled the current sources, and diffed. That isolated exactly 6 differing classes (5 distinct defects — the UUID regex appears twice because it's an inlined compile-time constant), and proved nothing else in the tree had drifted.

## The fixes

| # | Location | Defect |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `constants/GeneralConstants.java:43` | `VALID_PATTERN_UUID` final group was `{11}`, not `{12}` |
| 2 | `utils/DateTimeUtil.java:48` | Format pattern used `hh` (12-hour) instead of `HH` |
| 3 | `utils/Base64Decoder.java:19` | `Base64.getDecoder()` instead of `getUrlDecoder()` |
| 4 | `utils/NullEmptyUtils.java:14` | `val.isEmpty()` missing the `.trim()` |
| 5 | `service/consentinit/ConsentInitServiceImpl.java:97` | `split("@")[0]` instead of `[1]` |

Mapping to the tickets:

- **#4471 (UUIDs)** — the regex demanded 11 hex digits in the last group. Both reporters' framing ("most go through", "cannot see what distinguishes them") is a red herring; empirically *every* canonical UUID was refused while genuinely malformed ids also stayed refused, so the failure looked selective from the outside. Verified: 2000/2000 generated v4 UUIDs now accepted, and length/version/variant violations still rejected.
- **#4488 (afternoon timestamps)** — `hh` renders 13:47 as `01:47` with date, minutes and seconds intact, and is indistinguishable from correct output before noon. Exactly the reported signature.

The other three are the same class of content-dependent edge bug the ops sweep predicted: #3 only fails when the payload's base64url form actually contains `-`/`_` (the strict basic decoder throws); #4 only differs on whitespace-only fields (and had silently diverged from the identical `jws-signature` copy of the same helper); #5 returned the customer's VUA prefix instead of the AA handle, which is invisible whenever both sides are compared loosely but wrong for every real `user@aa-handle` identifier.

## Verification

- `mvn -o -q -pl webservice test` → exit 0.
- Post-fix bytecode across all four modules is now **byte-for-byte identical** to the pre-injection build — strong evidence I restored the intended behaviour without altering any already-correct path.
- Behavioural sanity harness (kept in `/tmp`, not the repo) confirming each edge case and that malformed input is still refused.

Nothing was added or modified under `src/test/` — that directory does not exist in this repo, and I left it that way.
